# infrawrench_cost_centres (Data Source)

Every cost centre in the organization, whoever created it.

This is how a configuration references centres that exist outside Terraform — pointing an `infrawrench_allocation_rule` at a hierarchy the finance team built in the UI, for instance, without importing those centres and taking ownership of them.

The API returns a flat list with a `parent_id` on each row; the tree is implied rather than nested, because a nested shape would be awkward to index into from HCL. Nesting is capped at four levels deep, so walking the parent chain terminates quickly.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cost_centres` (Attributes List) Cost centres, flat, in the order the API returned them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_centres))
- `id` (String) The organization id. A plural data source has no identity of its own; this is the conventional placeholder.

<a id="nestedatt--cost_centres"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cost_centres`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Free-text description, null when none was set.
- `id` (String) Cost centre id, as used by `infrawrench_allocation_rule`'s `cost_centre_id`.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `parent_id` (String) Id of the parent centre, null for a root centre.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change.
